synopsis: Chapter 9 and the glossary identify ASAM MDF 4.3.0, dated September 2025, as a standardized binary format for measured signals, bus traffic and sensor data, including metadata and synchronization; Chapter 9 also explicitly includes calculated signals [f7115, f13011]. MDF is a neutral format option rather than a mandatory architecture choice: other structured or in-house formats can satisfy the same architecture if provenance and long-term readability are controlled [f7116, f13012]. For test management, the glossary assigns MDF to measured data and ASAM ATX to test metadata, specifications and results, while ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 covers test documentation [f13537, f16029, f16254]. The resulting planning choice is conditional on data stewardship, not exclusive adoption of MDF [f7116, f13012].
